text: Hedge fund redemptions and margin calls, both liquidity reducing events, were the primary drivers of asset selloffs during the financial crisis of 2007-2008, and hedge fund investors are three times more likely than mutual fund investors to withdraw capital during market downturns.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy A. Krause, Hedge Funds and Systemic Risk (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2748096
abstract: hedge fund redemptions and margin calls, which are liquidity reducing events, were the primary drivers of selloffs during the financial crisis of 2007-2008. They demonstrate that hedge fund investors are three times more likely to withdraw capital during market downturns

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: comparison group is mutual fund investors
